items.evidence: The acceptance test passes. It asserts style, description words, empty mixed/deviations, 26 spots in APPLICABLE_SPOTS order, the exact D-2 count vector, justifications, parse equality and exact problems for missing description/range/BB re-raise. Holdout: rock.json deep-equals the spec §5 JSON. Read independently, there are 26 entries covering each spot once, every justification has >= 10 words, the description has >= 15 words, and mixedSpots/deviations are []. Killed by the Rock-requires-range and missing-spot mutants.

The acceptance test passes and asserts the exact problems for the 72o, BB re-raise 22/22, UTG union 39/39 and modified-chart AA cases. Holdout: computing directly from SIX_MAX_CHART, every Rock class is a TAG non-fold cell, every spot has fewer classes and the position unions are UTG 15<39, HJ 20<46, CO 29<57, BTN 45<82, SB 25<79, BB 41<169. My own mutations: BTN raise +32o gives the exact fold problem. SB blind-defence set to all 23 TAG classes gives the exact '23 ... not fewer than 23'. Unknown class ZZ, duplicate spot and a non-list each give exactly one problem. With a chart copy where HJ re-raise KK is F, the real rock.json gives exactly 'HJ re-raise has KK, which the TAG chart folds'. Killed by the subset-disabled, chart-pinned and both >=-to-> mutants.

The acceptance test passes and sweeps 25 owed>0 spots × out-of-range classes through decideRock and through the worker with 5 seeds. Example A: Rock folds and TAG calls 4. Holdout on my own collection (seed 777, seat 3, 2,162 preflop views, all 26 spots), with two card variants per class: 7,718 outside-range owed>0 substitutions all give exactly the legal fold. 1,382 of them are hands TAG plays. The worker's 'Rock' answer equals decideRock for seeds 0, 1, 99999, 4294967295 and a botDecisionSeed, so the result doesn't depend on the replay code.

The acceptance test passes: 157 outside classes give the legal check on every BB-limpers view, Example B has Rock check where TAG raises 8, and the worker gives the check for seeds 0 and max. Holdout: all 33 BB-limpers views owe 0, and 314 outside-range substitutions give exactly the legal check and never a fold. The owed>=0 mutant is killed.

The acceptance test passes. Example E: with AQo removed from an edited copy of the raw rock.json, the Rock folds views[79]. With the shipped file it raises 8. Removing AA from BB limpers turns a raise into a check. Adding QTo to BTN re-raise turns a fold into the advice call 8. 756 in-range substitutions equal recommend().move and never fold. The options.style-ignored mutant is killed.
